title: Animation Sampler
description: Combination of timestamps, keyframe data, and the interpolation mode.

input.title: Input Accessor
input.description: The index of the accessor providing keyframe timestamps.

interpolation.description: Interpolation mode used to compute animated property values between keyframes.

anyOf.title: Hermite Cubic Spline
anyOf.description: Values between the keyframes are interpolated using Hermite cubic splines.

anyOf.title: Linear
anyOf.description: Values between the keyframes are interpolated linearly. Rotation values use spherical linear interpolation.

anyOf.title: Step
anyOf.description: Values between the keyframes are equal to the output of the last played keyframe.

output.title: Output Accessor
output.description: The index of the accessor providing keyframe property values and additional values as needed by the interpolation mode.
